turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I've prepared the sweet rice dish and the eight fruits, Mother-in-law. I hope it meets your expectations.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry, I have taken care of the arrangements for the feast. The wine and sweet rice dish are all prepared, just as you wanted.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I'm glad you're feeling content today. I'll make sure to take good care of Father and the family, just as you've taught me.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, do not talk like this, you are my wife and the mother of my son, you will not leave us so soon. I will not have you worrying about such things when you are not well.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Why must you concern yourself with such things, O-lan, when you should be resting and getting well? The boy will be taken care of, I will not let him want for anything.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have lived my life, Wang Lung. It is not for me to worry about the future, but for you to tend to it.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not leave you until my son is married and settled, Wang Lung. I must see to it that he is secure.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, you must make sure the maid is well treated, and that she is content in her new life with you. I have seen how she cares for you, and I am grateful.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, I know you will take care of the maid, but I want you to promise me one thing: you will not forget your father's struggles when you were a child. He worked hard to build this life for us, and I want you to remember that.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Thank you, honorable mother, for your kindness to me. I will strive to take good care of your son and make him happy, as he is already kind and gentle to me.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I promise you I will not forget Father's struggles. I will work hard to make him proud, just as he has always been proud of me.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I am grateful for your trust in me, honorable mother. I will do my best to make you and Father proud of me, too.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will do everything in my power to make you happy in your last days. I promise to take care of Father and the farm, and to make sure the maid is well treated.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Don't worry, Mother, I will take good care of you and Father, and the maid will be happy here. I will make sure everything is done as you wish.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will try my best to make you happy, honorable mother, and to take good care of your son and Father, as you have taught me.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will make sure to take care of the farm and Father, so that we can live comfortably after you are gone, Mother. I know you are worried, but I promise to take good care of everything.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will arrange a marriage for myself as soon as possible, Mother, so that you can see me settled before you go.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will do everything to make you proud, Mother. I will be a good son and a good husband, and I will make you happy before you go.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, don't be too tired, I will take care of everything, I promise. I will ask the village matchmaker to come and arrange a marriage for me, and I will make sure to follow all your wishes, just as I always do.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will go now, honorable mother, and start making preparations for the son's marriage, as he has promised.
